content:
laura_sales: Heads-up: Prospect (FinServe EU) put vendor risk as a showstopper. They want three items: an EU-only data flow diagram, a CSV of subprocessors showing which handle PII, and a one-paragraph CAIQ-style answer about segmentation & key control. Need before their review tomorrow morning.

vince_presales: I can do the DFD + CSV. Quick check: they insist PII never leaves EU (no cross-border backups). Is Dedicated pinned to EU acceptable or must be on-prem Private?

laura_sales: Dedicated EU-only is fine. Hosted only if we can lock region and disable fallbacks/backups.

mina_security: Notes to include in artefact: KMS options (customer-managed in EU or Redwood HSM with split-escrow if contractually agreed), cache behavior (ephemeral in Hosted, persistent only on Dedicated/Private within EU), telemetry pseudonymization.

vince_presales: Draft config snippet for Hosted pin (pasteable):
```yaml
deployment:
  mode: hosted
  region_policy:
    allowed: [eu-west-1, eu-central-1]
    fallback: false
storage:
  backups:
    cross_region: false
    retention_region: eu-central-1
cache:
  persistent_kv: false
```

kevin_legal: When you publish subprocessors please add this sample clause for the DPA: "Redwood will notify Customer 30 days prior to onboarding any new subprocessor that may process Customer Data; Customer may reasonably object." I will adapt for contract language.

vince_presales: CSV preview rows I'll include: Google Cloud (compute/storage) 	 infra 	 PII (encrypted blobs) 	 EU zones; Datadog 	 monitoring 	 metrics (pseudonymized) 	 EU tenant; Sentry 	 errors 	 traces (PII-scrubbed) 	 EU hosts; Zendesk 	 support 	 ticket metadata 	 EU residency flag; HashiCorp Vault/Customer KMS 	 key mgmt 	 key material 	 EU/customer.

mina_security: Add: backups containing PII disabled, audit logs can be exported to EU-only buckets, KMS rotation recommended 90 days, key access logged and restricted.

laura_sales: Also need a short pricing bullet for ~50 RPS: Hosted (EU-pin) baseline estimate, Dedicated EU-only ~ +40% over Hosted, Private on-prem requires SOW. A ballpark is fine.

redwood-bot: asset uploaded: /internal/security/dfd/1780123456-finserve-eu-dfd.png (sha256:3b9f7a1c2d4e)

vince_presales: DFD uploaded. Will post CSV, CAIQ blurb, and quick pricing note in ~4 hours. Checklist:
- [x] Confirmed EU-only PII requirement
- [x] DFD PNG uploaded
- [ ] Subprocessor CSV to post
- [ ] CAIQ paragraph to post
- [ ] Pricing delta note to post

laura_sales: Great, once everything is here I'll forward to their security team. Thanks all :pray:
